name: Palo Dinner Soft Potato Gnocchi & Poached Lobster Pappardelle
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Dinner)
whyItWorks: Hand-rolled pillowy potato gnocchi and wide egg-pasta pappardelle with poached Maine lobster morsels are ultra-low-residue.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for the potato gnocchi or lobster pappardelle tossed in sage brown butter, olive oil, or light lobster bisque reduction (hold any wild mushrooms, leeks, or chili flakes).
watchOuts: Ask to hold mushrooms or leeks depending on the seasonal sauce
